answer: Your most recent HbA1c (average blood sugar over about three months) was 6.9%, taken on 16 February 2026. That is about eight months ago, and your records show no HbA1c since then. For many adults with type 2 diabetes, a level around 7% or below is the usual goal, but your doctor will set the target for you.
